source_note: Chinese hot-topic candidates are collected from public trend pages; English wording is matched to supplied official English headlines when possible, otherwise suggested neutrally.

topics.chinese_topic: 习近平出席“上海合作组织+”会议
topics.why_hot: The meeting is a high-profile diplomatic event, and the SCO-related agenda drew wide attention on Baidu.
topics.share_angle: Explain what the 'SCO Plus' format is and why China's participation matters for regional cooperation.

topics.chinese_topic: 华为、小米、荣耀回应涨价
topics.official_english: Huawei, Xiaomi and Honor Respond to Price Increase Reports
topics.why_hot: Major smartphone makers responding to price-increase reports fueled consumer discussion about device costs.
topics.share_angle: Break down what the brands said and what it could mean for smartphone buyers.

topics.chinese_topic: 中国制造的“机器鸭”卖断货
topics.official_english: China-Made Robotic Duck Product Sells Out
topics.why_hot: The sold-out robot duck went viral, reflecting curiosity about China-made gadgets.
topics.share_angle: Use the product as a lens to talk about the appeal of China's consumer tech and viral marketing.

topics.official_english: School Responds to Reports of Classes Exceeding 80 Students
topics.why_hot: News of a class with more than 80 students raised worries about education quality and teacher workload.
topics.share_angle: Explore the reasons behind oversized classes and the broader pressures on China's education system.

topics.chinese_topic: 人民日报：综艺节目不能“拍完就走”
topics.official_english: People's Daily: Variety Shows Should Not 'Leave Right After Filming'
topics.why_hot: A state-media commentary about variety shows sparked debate on what TV crews should do for local communities after filming.
topics.share_angle: Look at the debate over production ethics, site cleanup and community relations in China's entertainment industry.

topics.chinese_topic: 于东来痛批明星扎堆直播带货
topics.official_english: Yu Donglai Criticizes Celebrities for Flocking to Livestream Product Sales
topics.why_hot: The criticism struck a chord with internet users who have mixed views on celebrity livestream commerce.
topics.share_angle: Present both sides of the celebrity livestream e-commerce debate in China.

topics.chinese_topic: 尼泊尔泥石流灾害遇难人数升至1093人
topics.official_english: Nepal Mudslide Disaster Death Toll Rises to 1,093
topics.why_hot: The severe disaster in neighboring Nepal drew sympathy, and users followed updates on casualties and rescue efforts.
topics.share_angle: Cover the known toll and explain why the disaster has resonated with Chinese internet users.

topics.chinese_topic: 小区不要物业自己管自己 1天1户1块钱
topics.official_english: Residential Community Adopts Self-Management for 1 Yuan per Household per Day
topics.why_hot: A community's low-cost self-management experiment sparked debates about apartment management and property-services fees.
topics.share_angle: Explain how the self-management model works and what it suggests about alternatives to traditional property companies.
